forum_post: Eight and two. Point leader among anybody who's actually relevant, zero moves made out loud last week because I didn't need to make any noise to stay first - everybody else held their breath, I just kept winning. George, I've got you this week - 7-3 outscored by 48 points is not a record, it's a typo, and my worst starter beats your best unit. Selina, Gary - you counter my Henry-and-Ward offer for Allen by tacking Rice onto the ask? That's not a negotiation, that's a joke, and I don't negotiate jokes. Offer's dead, keep your quarterback, I've still got Burrow throwing for 400 whenever he feels like it. Dumbledore - word is you're whispering to me AND Patricia about the same guy on the same day. Pick a lane or I pick it for you. Golden Child stays golden. Kris, you're welcome for the column - I know you needed one.
